blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Hierarchical multi-label text classification (HMTC) requires models to capture both structural dependencies among labels and the fine-grained semantics of labels at different hierarchy levels. Existing methods often model hierarchy through prediction constraints or representations of individual labels and local relations. Structural and semantic supervision, however, are usually formulated separately. We instead use complete root-to-node label paths as a shared unit for both. Our framework introduces two auxiliary training objectives while retaining a standard multi-label classifier at inference. PathSimNCE aligns document representations with hierarchical paths using hierarchy-aware contrastive targets. These targets provide graded supervision for structurally related paths while preserving explicit supervision for the ground-truth paths. The complementary semantic objective uses LLM-generated, document-conditioned descriptions of the same positive paths. It thereby provides context-specific label semantics beyond static label representations. Experiments on three benchmarks show consistent improvements: structural alignment is particularly beneficial in deeper hierarchies, while semantic alignment provides additional gains for fine-grained labels.
blocks.zh: 分级多标签文本分类(HMTC)需要模型既能捕捉到标签之间的结构依赖性,又能捕捉到不同级别上标签的细纹语义. 现有方法往往通过预测限制或表达个人标签和地方关系来模拟等级. 然而,结构监督和语义监督通常单独制定。 我们使用完整的从根到节点的标签路径作为两者的共享单位. 我们的框架引入了两个辅助培训目标,同时在推论中保留一个标准的多标签分类器. PathSimNCE使用分级意识对比目标将文档表达式与分级路径相协调. 这些目标为结构相关路径提供分级监督,同时对地面真相路径保持明确的监督。 互补的语义目标使用LLM生成的,具有文档条件的相同正路描述. 因此它提供了超出静态标签表达的上下文特定标签语义. 三个基准的实验显示,一致性的改进:结构相接对更深层次尤其有益,而语义相接则为细纹标签提供了额外的收益.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: Hierarchical multi-label text classification (HMTC) assigns multiple labels organized in a predefined hierarchy to a document ( Liu et al., 2023a ) (Figure 1 ). It arises in applications such as news topic classification ( Kowsari et al., 2019 ) , scientific publication categorization ( Chen et al., 2024 ) , and book genre annotation ( Zhou et al., 2020 ) . Unlike flat multi-label classification, HMTC must account for dependencies among labels at different levels of granularity, ranging from broad categories to fine-grained concepts ( Zhong et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 分级的多标签文本分类(HMTC)将分级排列的多个标签分配给文档(Liu等人,2023a). (图1). 它出现在新闻主题分类(Kowsari等人,2019年),科学出版物分类(Chen等人,2024年),以及书籍流派注释(周等人,2020年)等应用中. 与平面多标签分类不同,HMTC必须说明不同颗粒度的标签之间的依赖性,从广义的分类到细纹的概念(Zhong等人,2026年).

blocks.en: Figure 1: An example of HMTC. Labels are organized in a top-down hierarchy from coarse to fine. Labels sharing the same color correspond to nodes along the same hierarchical label path.
blocks.zh: 图1:HMTC的例子. 标签按从粗到细的从上到下排列。 共享相同颜色的标签对应同一等级标签路径上的节点.

blocks.en: Two challenges are particularly important in this setting. First, standard label-wise objectives treat labels largely as independent prediction targets and do not explicitly capture structural relations such as ancestry and siblinghood ( Zhu et al., 2023 ) . This limitation becomes more consequential in deep hierarchies, where closely related labels may share substantial hierarchical context but differ only at lower levels. Second, label names alone often provide insufficient semantic information for distinguishing fine-grained categories ( Chen et al., 2021 ; Baldini Soares et al., 2019 ) . Effective HMTC therefore requires supervision that reflects both the structural proximity among labels and their document-specific semantic meanings.
blocks.zh: 在这方面有两个挑战特别重要。 首先,标准标签式目标主要将标签视为独立预测目标,没有明确捕捉祖先和兄弟姐妹等结构关系(Zhu等人,2023年). 这种限制在深层等级中变得更加严重,在这种等级中,密切关联的标签可能具有实质性的等级背景,但只在较低级别上有所不同。 其次,仅标签名称往往不足以提供区分细纹类的语义信息(Chen等人,2021年;Baldini Soares等人,2019年)。 因此,有效的HMTC需要监督,既反映标签之间的结构接近性,也反映其文件特有的语义含义。

blocks.en: Existing work incorporates hierarchical information primarily through prediction-level constraints or hierarchy-aware representation learning. Prediction-level approaches use structured inference, top-down decoding, or specialized prediction modules to enforce parent–child consistency ( Kim et al., 2024 ; Vaswani et al., 2025 ) . Representation-based approaches encode hierarchical relations using graph encoders, hierarchical attention, or structured label embeddings ( Sadat and Caragea, 2022 ; Zhu et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2026 ) . Other methods employ re-weighting, sampling, or metric-learning strategies to improve the prediction of fine-grained labels ( Cao et al., 2019 ; Huang et al., 2021 ) . Although effective, these methods often model structure and label semantics separately, leaving complete root-to-node paths underexplored as a common supervision unit for both.
blocks.zh: 现有工作主要通过预测层次的限制或了解层次代表性的学习纳入分级信息。 预测级方法采用结构化推论、自上而下解码或专门预测模块,以强化父母子女的一致性(Kim等人,2024年;Vaswani等人,2025年)。 基于代表的方法使用图表编码器编码等级关系,分级关注,或结构化标签嵌入(Sadat and Caragea, 2022;Zhu等人, 2024;Zhang等人, 2026). 其他方法采用重新加权,采样,或衡量学习策略,以改善细纹标签的预测(曹等人,2019年;黄等人,2021年). 这些方法虽然有效,但往往会将模型结构与标注语义分开,使完整的根到节点路径作为两者的共同监督单位未得到充分探讨.

blocks.en: In this work, we propose a path-level representation learning framework with complementary structural and semantic objectives. Each non-root label is associated with its root-to-node path, which preserves its full ancestral context. Our structural objective, PathSimNCE, aligns document and path representations using hierarchy-aware contrastive targets. It assigns graded supervision to structurally related paths while preserving explicit supervision for the ground-truth paths. Our semantic objective aligns documents with LLM-generated, document-conditioned descriptions of the same positive paths, providing fine-grained semantic supervision beyond static label names. Both objectives are used only during training and complement the standard label-wise classification loss. At inference time, only the text encoder and multi-label classifier are retained.
blocks.zh: 在这项工作中,我们提出了一个具有互补结构和语义目标的路径层代表性学习框架。 每个非根的标签都与其根至节的路径相关,这保留了它完整的祖传背景. 我们的结构目标,PathSimNCE,将文档和路径的表达方式用层次感对比性目标来协调. 它指定对结构相关路径进行分级监督,同时对地面真相路径保持明确的监督。 我们的语义目标将文档与LLM生成的,具有文档条件的相同正路径描述相配合,提供除静态标签名称外的细纹语义监督. 这两个目标仅在培训期间使用,并补充标准标签分类损失。 在推论时间,只保留文本编码器和多标签分类器.

blocks.en:
Our contributions are summarized as follows: • We propose a path-level framework that uses root-to-node paths as a common unit for structural and semantic supervision, without introducing additional inference-time components. • We introduce PathSimNCE, a structural alignment objective that uses hierarchy-aware contrastive targets to provide graded supervision over hierarchical paths while preserving explicit supervision for the ground-truth paths. • We introduce a complementary semantic alignment objective based on document-conditioned path descriptions generated offline by an LLM, providing fine-grained semantic supervision. • We conduct experiments on three HMTC
benchmarks and analyze the proposed objectives across hierarchy depths, label frequencies, and representation spaces.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: We review prior work on HMTC, focusing on prediction- and constraint-based methods, representation-based hierarchical modeling, and hierarchy-aware contrastive learning.
blocks.zh: 我们审查了以前关于HMTC的工作,重点是预测和制约方法、基于代表性的等级模型和对等级的对比性学习。

blocks.en: Prediction- and constraint-based approaches incorporate hierarchical dependencies directly into label prediction. Some methods extend flat multi-label classifiers with hierarchy-regularized objectives or structured inference, while others employ level- or node-specific classifiers followed by top-down or node-wise prediction ( Kowsari et al., 2017 ; Shimura et al., 2018 ) . To reduce the complexity of local classification, the hierarchy may be partitioned by level, parent, or node ( Stein et al., 2019 ; Peng et al., 2018 ; Krendzelak and Jakab, 2021 ) . Sequential formulations further represent hierarchical classification as a sequence of label-assignment decisions ( Mao et al., 2019 ; Im et al., 2023 ) . These approaches can explicitly model prediction dependencies and enforce hierarchical consistency. However, top-down and sequential decisions may propagate errors from coarse to fine levels, and many such methods require hierarchy-specific prediction or inference procedures.
blocks.zh: 基于预测和制约的办法将等级依赖性直接纳入标签预测。 一些方法将平面多标签分类器扩展为层次规范化目标或结构化推论,而其他方法则采用层次或节点特定分类器,然后是自上而下或节点式预测(Kowsari等人,2017年;Shimura等人,2018年). 为降低本地分类的复杂性,分级可能按级别,父,或节点进行划分(Stein等人,2019年;Peng等人,2018年;Krendzelak和Jakab,2021年). 序列式配体进一步代表了等级分类作为标签分配决定的序列(Mao等人,2019年;Im等人,2023年). 这些方法可以明确模拟预测的依赖性,并加强等级一致性。 然而,自上而下和相继作出的决定可能把错误从粗糙的层次传播到细微的层次,而且许多这类方法需要分层次的预测或推论程序。

blocks.en: Representation-based methods incorporate hierarchical structure into document or label representations rather than enforcing it solely through prediction-time constraints. Common strategies include graph-based encoders, hierarchy-aware attention, structured message passing, and specialized geometric spaces. For instance, Zhou et al. (2020) encode hierarchical relationships within a unified classification model, while Chen et al. (2021) formulate hierarchical classification as text–label semantic matching. Other studies enrich label representations using knowledge graphs and label attention ( Liu et al., 2023b ; Kumar and Toshniwal, 2025 ) , or employ tree-isomorphic networks to represent complex hierarchical topologies ( Zhu et al., 2023 ; Liu et al., 2025a ) . These methods demonstrate the value of learning hierarchy-aware representations, although many introduce dedicated graph, attention, or geometric modules that remain part of the model architecture.
blocks.zh: 以代表为基础的方法将等级结构纳入文件或标签中,而不是仅仅通过预测时间的限制加以执行。 共同的战略包括基于图表的编码器,分级意识的注意,结构化的信息传递,以及专门的几何空间. 例如,"周书"等. (2020年)在统一的分类模型中编码了等级关系,而陈等. (2021)制定等级分类作为文本–label语义匹配. 其他研究利用知识图和标签关注来丰富标签表达(Liu等人,2023年b;Kumar和Toshniwal,2025年),或利用树同位素网络来代表复杂的等级地形(Zhu等人,2023年;Liu等人,2025年a年)。 这些方法显示了学习的分级-意识表示值,尽管许多方法引入了专门的图,注意力,或几何模块,这些模块仍然是模型架构的一部分.

blocks.en: Hierarchy-aware contrastive learning aligns texts, instances, or labels in a shared representation space while using hierarchical relations to construct contrastive supervision. Prior work has explored hierarchy-aware positive and negative sample construction ( Xiong et al., 2026 ) , including negative paths or labels selected according to their positions in the hierarchy ( Zhou et al., 2025 ) . Other approaches inject hierarchical information into the text encoder ( Wang et al., 2022 ) , or jointly contrast instances and labels while accounting for their hierarchical relations ( U et al., 2023 ; Li et al., 2026 ) . Hierarchical margins and rebalancing strategies have also been introduced to improve contrastive learning for infrequent or fine-grained labels ( Kim et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ) . Collectively, these studies show that hierarchical relations can improve representation learning, but many contrastive formulations express supervision through discrete positive–negative assignments, margin constraints, or specialized hierarchy-aware modules.
blocks.zh: 分级-意识对比性学习在使用分级关系构建对比性监督的同时,将文本,例,或标签在共享的表示空间进行校对. 先前的工作探索了分级认识正反的样本构建(Xiong等人,2026年),包括根据其在分级中的位置选择的负路径或标签(周等人,2025年). 其他方法在文本编码器中注入分级信息(Wang等人,2022年),或者在计算其分级关系时联合对比实例和标签(U等人,2023年;Li等人,2026年). 还实行了等级差值和再平衡战略,以改进对不常见或细微标签的对比性学习(Kim等人,2024年;Zhang等人,2024年)。 这些研究集体表明,分级关系可以改善代表性学习,但许多对比性表述通过离散的正负派、差值限制或专门的分级意识模块来表达监督。

blocks.en: Our framework follows this representation-learning direction but uses root-to-node label paths as a common unit for structural and semantic supervision. PathSimNCE incorporates hierarchical structure into the learning objective through path-similarity-based contrastive targets, assigning graded supervision to structurally related paths while preserving explicit supervision for the ground-truth paths. A complementary description alignment objective supplies document-conditioned semantic supervision for the same paths. Both objectives are used only during training, allowing the model to retain a standard multi-label prediction architecture at inference.
blocks.zh: 我们的框架遵循这种表现-学习方向,但使用根到节点标签路径作为结构和语义监督的共同单元。 PathSimNCE通过基于路径的相似性对比目标,将分级结构纳入学习目标,将分级监督分配给与结构相关的路径,同时对地面-真实路径保持明确的监督. 辅助描述对齐目标提供文件附加条件的语义对相同路径的监督. 这两个目标仅在培训期间使用,使得模型在推论中能够保留一个标准的多标签预测架构.

blocks.en: 3 Methodology
blocks.zh: 3 方法

blocks.en: We propose a path-level representation learning framework that augments a standard HMTC classifier with complementary structural and semantic alignment objectives during training (Figure 2 ). For structural alignment, document representations and root-to-node label paths are projected into a shared contrastive space, where PathSimNCE provides graded supervision based on hierarchical path similarity while preserving explicit supervision for the ground-truth paths. For semantic alignment, document representations are aligned with document-conditioned path descriptions generated offline by an LLM. The two alignment objectives are jointly optimized with the standard label-wise classification loss, enabling the model to integrate label prediction, hierarchical structure, and fine-grained semantics during training. At inference time, only the text encoder and standard multi-label classifier are retained, without requiring path representations, descriptions, or a hierarchy-specific decoder.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一个路径层面的代表学习框架,以在培训期间补充结构和语义协调目标的方式,加强标准HMTC分类器(图2)。 对于结构对齐,文档表达和根到节点的标签路径被投射到一个共享的对比空间,PathSimNCE根据层次路径相似性提供分级监督,同时对地面-真实路径保持明确的监督. 对于语义上的对齐,文档表达方式与LLM线下生成的文档条件化路径描述一致. 两个对齐目标与标准标签式分类损失共同优化,使模型在训练期间能够整合标签预测,等级结构,以及精细纹理的语义. 在推论时间,只保留文本编码器和标准多标签分类器,而不需要路径表示,描述,或分级特定的解码器.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Overview of the proposed hierarchy-aware representation learning framework. (a) Instead of treating labels as isolated identifiers, each label is associated with its root-to-node path in the hierarchy. The model is jointly optimized with three objectives: binary cross-entropy (BCE), PathSimNCE, and description alignment. (b) Description alignment uses LLM-generated path descriptions to provide complementary semantic supervision during training only. (c) PathSimNCE performs hierarchy-aware contrastive learning by combining text–path and path–path similarities to generate soft structural supervision targets.
blocks.zh: 图 2: 拟议分级认识代表性学习框架概述。 (a) 每一标签与其作为孤立的标识符处理,而是与其等级中的根到节点路径相关联。 该模型与三个目标共同优化:二进制交叉(BCE),PathSimNCE,以及描述对齐. (b) 描述对齐使用LLM生成的路径描述,只在培训期间提供补充语义监督。 (c) PathSimNCE通过将文本-路径和路径-路径的相似性结合起来来进行分级认识对比学习,从而产生软结构监督目标。

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We propose a path-level structural and semantic alignment framework for hierarchical multi-label text classification. It uses complete root-to-node label paths as a shared unit for structural and semantic supervision. We use two auxiliary training objectives. PathSimNCE aligns document representations with hierarchical paths using graded structural supervision while preserving explicit supervision for the ground-truth paths. The complementary semantic objective uses document-conditioned descriptions of the same positive paths to capture context-specific label semantics. Both objectives are training-only. The model retains a standard multi-label classifier without additional inference-time inputs or computation.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一个分级多标签文本分类的路径层次结构和语义协调框架。 它使用完整的根对节点标签路径作为结构和语义监督的共享单元. 我们使用两个辅助训练目标。 PathSimNCE通过分级结构监督使文件表述与分级路径保持一致,同时对地面真实路径保持明确的监督. 互补语义目标使用文档条件化的描述相同正路径来捕捉上下文特定的标签语义. 这两项目标是只培训。 该模型保留了一个标准的多标签分类器,没有额外的推论时间输入或计算.

blocks.en: Experiments on three datasets show consistent improvements. Structural alignment is particularly beneficial in deeper hierarchies, while semantic alignment provides additional gains for fine-grained labels. These results support hierarchical paths as a common interface for combining structural and semantic supervision. In future, we plan to extend the framework to more general hierarchies, including taxonomies allowing multiple parents per label. We will also investigate more scalable approaches to constructing and using path descriptions for large label hierarchies.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en:
Our framework has several limitations. First, it assumes that a reliable label hierarchy is available and that each non-root label has a unique parent. Consequently, the current path construction and structural targets cannot be directly applied to more general taxonomies in which labels have multiple parents. Moreover, when the given hierarchy is noisy, incomplete, or weakly related to label
semantics, path-level supervision may become less informative.
blocks.zh:
我们的框架有几个局限性。 首先,它假设有可靠的标签等级,并且每个非根标签都有独特的父标签. 因此,目前的路径构造和结构目标不能直接适用于标签有多重父母的更普遍的分类。 此外,当给定的等级关系吵闹、不完整或与标签关系薄弱时
语义学,路径层面的监督可能变得信息较少.

blocks.en:
Second, description alignment relies on LLM-generated,
document-conditioned path descriptions. Although these descriptions are generated offline and used only during training, their generation introduces additional pre-processing cost, particularly for large
datasets with many document–path pairs. Inaccurate, overly generic, or biased descriptions may also introduce noisy semantic supervision and reduce the benefits of description alignment.

其次,描述对齐依赖于LLM生成,
文档条件路径描述。 虽然这些描述是离线生成的,只在培训期间才使用,但其生成带来了额外的预处理费用,特别是对于大型的
含有许多文档-路径对的数据集。 不准确,过于笼统,或带有偏见的描述也可能引入吵闹的语义监督,减少描述对齐的好处.

blocks.en: Finally, the proposed objectives inject structural and semantic information during training but do not impose hard hierarchical constraints on predictions. Because labels are still predicted independently by a standard multi-label classifier, the resulting label set is not guaranteed to be hierarchically consistent at inference time.

blocks.en: Appendix B GPT Prompt
blocks.zh: 附录B GPT 提示

blocks.en: We generate one semantic description for each gold text-path pair using GPT-4o and reuse these descriptions as auxiliary supervision during training. The procedure has three steps: (1) serialize the gold root-to-label path into a textual path string; (2) pair the path string with the source abstract; and (3) prompt the LLM to generate a concise explanation of how the document content matches the hierarchical path. We used the following prompt to generate the path descriptions using GPT-4o.
blocks.zh: 我们使用GPT-4o为每对金文本路径生成一个语义描述,并将这些描述作为培训期间的辅助监督。 该程序有三个步骤: (1)将金根至标签路径序列化为文本路径字符串; (2)将路径字符串与源抽象对齐; (3)促使LLM生成一个简明的解释,说明文档内容如何与层次路径相匹配. 我们用以下提示来生成路径描述 使用 GPT-4o 。

blocks.en: ⬇ Abstract : "{ abstract }" Hierarchical Label Path : { label_path_str } Task : Generate a detailed description that : - Defines each label in the hierarchy and their relationships . - Explains how the abstract content corresponds to each label . - Avoids introducing external or unrelated information . - Uses professional and academic language . - Is approximately 200 words in length .

blocks.en: Appendix C Case Analysis
blocks.zh: 附录C 案例分析

blocks.en: To qualitatively examine how the two auxiliary objectives affect the final predictions, Table 5 presents two representative cases from the BGC test set. We compare the BCE baseline, the variants with PathSimNCE or description alignment, and the Full Model. All variants use the same standard multi-label prediction architecture and differ only in the supervision introduced during training.
blocks.zh: 为了从质量上审查两个辅助目标如何影响最终预测,表5列出了BGC测试组的两个有代表性的案例. 我们比较了BCE基线,变体与PathSimNCE或描述对齐,以及Full Model. 所有变体都使用相同的标准多标签预测架构,仅在培训期间引入的监督中有所不同.

blocks.en: In Case 1, the BCE baseline identifies only the coarse labels Fiction and Science Fiction . Adding PathSimNCE further recovers Mystery & Suspense and Suspense & Thriller , while description alignment additionally identifies Mystery & Suspense and the semantically specific label Cyber Punk . The Full Model recovers the complete ground-truth label set. In Case 2, both auxiliary objectives recover the missing labels Fiction and Fiction Classics , but each single-objective variant also introduces one additional category. The Full Model retains the complete ground-truth label set without these extra predictions.
blocks.zh: 在案例1中,BCE基线只识别粗糙的标签虚构和科幻. 添加路径SimNCE进一步恢复了Mystery & Suspense and Suspense & Thriller,同时描述对齐还额外识别了Mystery & Suspense和Sematic上的专用标签Cyber Punk. Full Model恢复了完整的地面真实标签集. 在案例2中,两个辅助目标都回收缺失的标签虚构和虚构经典(Fiction and Fiction Classics),但每个单目标变体也引入一个附加类别. Full Model保留了完整的地面真实标记集,而没有这些额外的预测.

blocks.en: Overall, these cases illustrate that PathSimNCE and description alignment provide complementary structural and semantic supervision. Their joint optimization can lead to more complete and precise label predictions while retaining the standard multi-label classification architecture.
blocks.zh: 总的来说,这些案例表明PathSimNCE和描述式的配合提供了互补的结构和语义监督. 它们的联合优化可以导致更加完整和准确的标签预测,同时保留标准多标签分类架构.

blocks.en: Appendix E Performance across Label Frequencies
blocks.zh: 附录E 横跨标签框的性能

blocks.en: We further examine whether the proposed objectives benefit labels with different training frequencies. Labels are ranked by their numbers of training instances and divided into five equally sized percentile groups, ordered from the most frequent to the least frequent. Figure 5 reports the Macro-F1 gain of each variant over the BCE baseline within each group.
blocks.zh: 我们进一步审查拟议目标是否有利于使用不同培训频率的标签。 标签按培训次数排序,分为5个同样大小的百分位组,从最经常到最不经常订购。 图5报告了每个变体在每一组中相对于BCE基线的宏观-F1收益。

blocks.en:
All variants generally improve over BCE across the frequency groups, although the magnitude of the improvement varies. PathSimNCE provides consistent gains across both frequent and less frequent labels, while the effect of description alignment alone is comparatively modest. Notably, the full model achieves its largest improvement in the lowest-frequency group, suggesting that structural and semantic supervision are complementary for labels with limited training
examples.
blocks.zh:
所有变体在跨频组中一般都比BCE有所改善,尽管改进的程度各有不同. PathSimNCE在频繁和较少的标签上提供一致的增益,而单是描述对齐的效果相对不大. 值得注意的是,整个模型在最低频率组中取得了最大的改进,这表明结构和语义监督是对培训有限的标签的补充
实例。

blocks.en: To complement the cosine-similarity heatmaps in Figure 4 , we use t-SNE to visualize the learned text and path representations on BGC (Figure 7 ), using the same 15 representative paths. Same-colored circles denote text representations whose ground-truth label sets contain a given path, and the matching star denotes its path representation. Thus, both figures examine the same text groups and paths from different perspectives.
blocks.zh: 为了补充图4中的同位素热图,我们使用t-SNE在BGC(图7)上可视化所学的文本和路径表示,使用相同的15条代表性路径. 同色圆表示其地面-真实标签集包含特定路径的文本表示,匹配星表示其路径表示. 因此,这两个数字都从不同的角度审查了相同的文本组和路径。

blocks.en: In Figure 7 , text representations associated with each ground-truth path generally lie close to its path representation under both BCE+PathSimNCE and the Full Model. This spatial proximity complements the diagonal dominance in Figure 4 ’s heatmaps, where diagonal entries exceed off-diagonal similarity scores, jointly illustrating the learned document–path alignment. The Full Model preserves this alignment after incorporating description-based semantic supervision, consistent with the heatmap results.
blocks.zh: 在图7中,与每一地面-真实路径相关的文字表述一般都与其在BCE+PathSimNCE和Full Model下的路径表述相近。 这种空间相近性补充了图4的热图中的对角优势,其中对角分数超过了离对角相似性分数,共同说明了学到的文档-路径对齐性。 Full Model在纳入基于描述的语义监督后,按照热映射结果保留了这种对齐.
